info.title: LegalEntities API
info.description: API for managing legal entities associated with accounts.

get.summary: Get Legal Entities for an Account
get.description: Retrieves a list of legal entities for the specified account ID. The response format depends on the `includeDetails` query parameter.

parameters.name: includeDetails
parameters.description: Indicates whether to include detailed information for each legal entity.

200.description: OK. Returns the legal entities for the account.

404.description: Not Found. No legal entities were found for the given account ID.

get.description: Retrieves details for a specific legal entity associated with a given account and legal entity ID.

parameters.name: legalEntityId
parameters.description: The ID of the legal entity.

parameters.name: includeAllAgreements
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to include all agreements for the legal entity.

200.description: OK. Returns the details of the legal entity.

404.description: Not Found. No legal entity was found for the provided account and legal entity ID.

Id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

Href.description: The hyperlink to access the resource.

LegalEntity.description: Represents a legal entity associated with an account.
